question: Should Control UI add a separate expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should long-prompt UX stay with the current inline autogrow plus configurable send shortcut?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested modal, but adding a second composer mode is a UX/product choice with nontrivial draft and keyboard semantics, not a strict bug fix.

options.title: Approve expanded composer modal
options.body: Keep this issue open and sponsor a focused Control UI PR that adds the modal editor flow with draft, focus, attachment, queued-send, and keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer inline composer only
options.body: Close or narrow this issue after deciding that the existing autogrow and send-shortcut setting are the intended long-prompt UX.

options.title: Defer until composer direction changes
options.body: Leave this as low-priority UX debt until maintainers revisit broader composer interactions.

recommendation.title: Approve expanded composer modal
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and sponsor a focused Control UI PR that adds the modal editor flow with draft, focus, attachment, queued-send, and keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and owns adjacent send-shortcut behavior, making them the clearest available product-routing owner from the evidence.
